whyMatters.en: Nashville Followill family band that moved from raw Southern garage rock to arena alt-radio with Only by the Night (2008); Sex on Fire is the crossover spike.
whyMatters.zh: 纳什维尔 Followill 家族乐队：从毛糙南方 garage 摇滚转到 Only by the Night（2008）的体育场 alternative 电台；Sex on Fire 是跨界峰值。

shortBio.en: Followill family alt-rock; Sex on Fire and Use Somebody are the 2008 crossover pair.
shortBio.zh: Followill 家族 alt-rock；Sex on Fire 与 Use Somebody 是 2008 跨界双曲。

body.en:
Formed 1999 in Nashville—three brothers plus cousin Matthew on lead guitar. Early albums (Youth & Young Manhood, Aha Shake Heartbreak) pushed rawer riffs and Caleb’s strained vocal; Because of the Times (2007) expanded delay and dynamics.

Sex on Fire (2008) and Use Somebody (2008) are the chart objects. They matter as a US path into stadium indie—Southern rock DNA under polished alt-radio production.
body.zh:
1999 年于纳什维尔组建——三兄弟加堂兄 Matthew 任 lead 吉他。早期专辑（Youth & Young Manhood、Aha Shake Heartbreak）推更毛糙 riff 与 Caleb 绷紧人声；Because of the Times（2007）扩展延时与动态。

Sex on Fire（2008）与 Use Somebody（2008）是榜单对象。意义是美国路径进入体育场 indie——抛光 alt 电台制作下仍有南方摇滚 DNA。

note.en: Delay-washed lead riff and strained Caleb vocal—Only by the Night arena template.
note.zh: 延时 lead riff 与 Caleb 绷紧人声——Only by the Night 体育场模板。

note.en: Piano-led ballad with U2-scale reverb—global rock radio second wave.
note.zh: 钢琴主导谣曲配 U2 级混响——全球摇滚电台第二波。

note.en: Early Youth & Young Manhood cut—garage Riff and raw vocal before arena polish.
note.zh: 早期 Youth & Young Manhood 曲——体育场抛光前的 garage Riff 与毛人声。

title.zh: 南方 garage 到体育场 alt-rock

body.en:
Kings of Leon matter as a family-band arc from rough indie garage to global rock radio—same four Followills, different production budget.

Youth & Young Manhood (2003) and Aha Shake Heartbreak (2004) document Strokes-era rawness with Nashville/Southern rock undertow.

Only by the Night (2008) is the commercial pivot: delay guitars, big room reverb, singalong choruses.

Sex on Fire’s lead riff and Caleb’s falsetto strain are the cited crossover moves.
body.zh:
Kings of Leon 要紧处是家族乐队弧线：从毛糙 indie garage 到全球摇滚电台——同一批 Followill，不同制作预算。

Youth & Young Manhood（2003）与 Aha Shake Heartbreak（2004）记录 Strokes 时代毛糙感加纳什维尔/南方摇滚潜流。

Only by the Night（2008）是商业拐点：延时吉他、大空间混响、合唱副歌。

Sex on Fire 的 lead riff 与 Caleb 假声绷紧是被引用的跨界动作。

body.en:
1999–present core unchanged: Caleb (vocals/rhythm), Jared (bass), Nathan (drums), Matthew (lead guitar, joined 2000).

No singer swap across the catalog—arc is production and songwriting maturity, not personnel churn.

Early live sets ran short, loud, and garage; post-2008 tours scale delay and arena PA.

Matthew’s lead lines grow from blues bends to U2-style dotted-eighth delay figures.
body.zh:
1999 至今核心未变：Caleb（人声/节奏）、Jared（贝斯）、Nathan（鼓）、Matthew（lead 吉他，2000 年加入）。

目录无换主唱——弧线是制作与写作成熟，非人员流动。

早期现场短、响、garage；2008 后巡演放大延时与体育场 PA。

Matthew 的 lead 线从蓝调推弦长到 U2 式附点八分延时音型。

title.en: US stadium indie after UK revival
title.zh: 英国复兴后的美国体育场 indie

body.en:
Kings of Leon show a US parallel to 2000s UK indie stadium acts—Pixies-style dynamic shifts filtered through Southern rock vocal strain.

Only by the Night’s chart run opened US alt-radio to family-band guitar rock alongside Coldplay-scale ballads.

Later records split critical and commercial reception but 2008 remains the citation year.

Influence is radio format and production gloss more than riff invention.
body.zh:
Kings of Leon 展示 2000 年代英国 indie 体育场乐队在美国的平行线——Pixies 式动态切换经南方摇滚人声绷紧过滤。

Only by the Night 榜跑让美国 alt 电台同时接纳家族乐队吉他摇滚与 Coldplay 级谣曲。

后期唱片评论与商业分裂，2008 仍是引用年。

影响在电台格式与制作光泽，多于 riff 发明。
